why_trail.why: Execution starts from the ratified narrow plan: derive attribution only from validated spine paths and prove parent/child behavior without lifecycle or #441 expansion.
The implementer committed the narrow two-writer helper and discriminating real linked-worktree regression. Independent replay passed 111 focused tests; no #441 or lifecycle behavior changed.
A fresh independent reviewer reproduced the focused suite and named regressions, verified the strict lexical helper and both writers, and found no release, schema, lifecycle, or #441 expansion.
Independent review and my own rerun confirm the corrected child attribution, parent Stop/release behavior, SessionStart binding, strict malformed-path handling, and full focused rail suite.
